description: T2.M1 item 2 and T2.1 check 1: gi.stats.recompiles (compute pipelines made while the platform is ready) stays 0 while 1,000 instances (and about 20 meshes) are created, moved and destroyed in random order, and then while 4,096 lights of every type are created (the light table doubling from 64) and destroyed in random order, with DDGI updating on the cabinet row; a control kernel made afterwards counts 1.
